name: Active Loop Picker
author: JC
summary: Pick any stored loop as Active; saved with a red pad when none of yours is lost; auto-advance on exit.
description: Pick a stored loop as the Active Loop with no playhead jump; it engages when reached. At load the rekordbox Active loop is armed. SHIFT+MEMORY cycles loops ahead. SHIFT+pad arms a hot-cue loop and, if none of yours would be lost, saves it as the Active Loop (red breathing pad). SHIFT+the pad again turns it off. Only a copy this mod saved is deleted. Analysis files are read-only. Firmware 2.00/2.01 only. The jog can show a static red ACTIVE LOOP Time and/or Bar instead of artwork (Jog shows, default Time + Bar; Off is stock; Custom is left alone). Settings sit under its Active Loop heading.
